title: Cash agent bookings and staged field payroll handovers
applicability: Cash instructions with more than one handover window
content:
An agent may accept a reservation before its physical desk opens. book_until governs when capacity can be reserved, handover_from governs earliest physical handover, and reservation_expiry governs latest handover. Inventory counting is separate from reservation. A reservation holds principal capacity and charges its nonrefundable fee; it does not guarantee a provisional denomination mix. a_request_cash_inventory publishes the actual mix after the agent's count delay. a_allocate_cash_notes assigns only counted stock. These fields live on xp_a_cash_agents and the ordinary cash pickup tools apply.
A staged cash instruction is recorded as handover_windows on the linked xp_a_settlement_terms row. Each window contains from_minute, due_minute, amount_minor and minimum_notes. Actual handovers must fall in a window and together meet that window's principal and denomination requirements. A recipient may not be ready or authorized to receive later payroll early. The system can still physically hand over cash outside the customer's window; that does not satisfy the instruction. A delivery cannot be counted in two windows. Requested denominations refer to physical notes, not an electronic wallet balance. Agent capacity, denomination stock, per-pickup authority, wallet balance limit and the common fee budget all remain independent constraints. Money transferred into a wallet cannot be recalled during this business session.
